verdict.rationale: Salv Cases lets analysts open a case, attach related alerts, customers and transactions, and work it with notes, documents, an assignee and a status. The case appears on every customer, counterparty, payment and alert it touches, so evidence and notes are recorded in the investigation. Auto-closed alerts also stay on the record as an audit trail. Missing for 10: an explicit field or flow for capturing decision reasons on manual closures, documentation of a chronological investigation history or timeline, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
